evidence.note: Create now plans shards, ingests results, writes packs with rollback, and prunes/GCs only after the run is recorded; diff is complete (part 1/1, not truncated), no eval, no TODO/FIXME markers.

New 215-line test file exercising the shard-pack wiring through Create via a fakeWriter seam on Options.ShardWriter, with a real git repo whose branch diff exceeds the context cap so a multi-shard plan is actually produced.

TestTaskDonePlanIsWrittenAndPrunedWithMatchingHash asserts one Write and one Prune, a non-empty plan and plan hash, header scope/budget, non-empty branch files, and that the emitted context pack names the same plan hash and the .metareview/shards/task-done/ pack directory.

TestTaskDonePackWriteFailureFailsTheRun injects a Write error and asserts the run fails and leaves no review artifacts; TestTaskDonePackRollbackRunsWhenTheReviewFails chmods docs/metareview/reviews read-only and asserts exactly one rollback with zero Prune/GC calls.

TestTaskDoneHousekeepingFailuresDoNotDiscardTheRun (prune and gc subtests) proves swallowed housekeeping errors keep the RunID; TestTaskDoneDiscoversShardResults proves ingestShardResults calls Discover exactly once on a sharded run.

go test -cover ./internal/taskdone/ reports 81.9% (was 24.6%); go tool cover -func on the new tests alone shows Create 83.0%, ingestShardResults 88.9%, manifestContext 100%, reviewerContext 100%, contextMarkdown 100%. All five tests PASS, none skipped.
GC is gated on !result.Blocking and result.Blocking is genuinely assigned inside the write closure at review.go:209, so the ordering claim in the comment holds.

findings.note: Prior blocker: the shard-pack wiring in internal/taskdone/review.go (Create, ingestShardResults, manifestContext) shipped without tests, unlike the structurally identical pr-ready code. Resolved by internal/taskdone/shardwiring_test.go, which drives the wiring end to end through Create with a fake shardpack.Writer over a real oversized-diff git repo. The tests are substantive, not superficial: they assert the plan/header/branch-files actually handed to the writer, the plan hash and pack directory surfaced in the context pack, failure of the run on a Write error with no artifacts left behind, exactly one rollback and zero housekeeping calls when the review body fails, survival of the RunID through Prune and GC errors, and a single Discover call per sharded run. Package coverage 24.6% -> 81.9%; the wired functions are covered at 83.0%/88.9%/100%.
